title: Singleton Coalition and Pivotality
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, let $i$ be one of its coordinates, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. A coalition consisting only of coordinate $i$ can attain both output signs from $x$ if and only if flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is an input in the sign cube
